description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Torentify is seeking a Full Stack Engineer to maintain and enhance cloud-based applications, contributing to backend and frontend development. The role includes building APIs and web applications, supporting production services, and collaborating on AWS deployments.
Full Stack Engineer maintaining cloud applications, developing Python/Node.js APIs and backend services, and supporting React/TypeScript web interfaces

Responsibilities:
• Maintain and enhance existing cloud-based applications
• Troubleshoot software bugs, implement fixes, and support production services
• Develop and maintain backend functionality using Python and/or Node.js
• Support frontend development using React and TypeScript
• Build and maintain APIs and web applications
• Collaborate with DevOps engineers on AWS-based deployments
• Investigate technical issues and apply effective debugging and problem-solving skills

Requirements:
• 1–3+ years of relevant professional experience
• Professional experience with one or more of the following technologies: Python, TypeScript, Node.js, or React
• Experience building or maintaining APIs and web applications
• Familiarity with AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
• Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
• U.S. citizenship and U.S. residency
